paper_title: Generating Diverse Training Samples for Relation Extraction with Large   Language Models
caption: Micro F1 (%) of KnowPrompt using different numbers of training samples generated by LLMs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промяната на метриката Micro F1 (%) за модела KnowPrompt при използване на различен брой генерирани от големи езикови модели (LLMs) тренировъчни примери, като сравнява четири различни метода: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED и SemEval. Оста X, означена като „Number of Samples Generated“, представлява броя на генерираните примери и е дискретна, с четири етикета: K=8, K=16, K=32 и K=64, които съответстват на 8, 16, 32 и 64 примера. Оста Y, означена като „Micro F1 (%)“, е линейна и обхваща диапазона от 22% до 52%, с етикети на всеки 5% (25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50). Диаграмата включва четири линии, всяка с различен цвят и маркер: синя линия с кръгови маркери за TACRED, оранжева линия с триъгълни маркери за TACRED-Revisit, зелена линия с ромбовидни маркери за Re-TACRED и червена линия с квадратни маркери за SemEval. Синята линия (TACRED) започва при ~23% при K=8, расте до ~28% при K=16, достига връх от ~30.5% при K=32 и след това леко спада до ~29.5% при K=64. Оранжевата линия (TACRED-Revisit) започва при ~23.5% при K=8, расте до ~29.5% при K=16, достига ~31% при K=32 и леко спада до ~30% при K=64. Зелената линия (Re-TACRED) започва при ~34.5% при K=8, расте до ~40.5% при K=16, достига връх от ~50.5% при K=32 и след това спада до ~48% при K=64. Червената линия (SemEval) започва при ~42% при K=8, расте до ~45% при K=16, достига ~47.5% при K=32 и продължава да расте до ~51.5% при K=64.
model_annotations.English: The line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) performance of the KnowPrompt model when trained using varying numbers of synthetic training samples generated by large language models (LLMs), across four different sampling strategies: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Samples Generated,” is categorical and displays four discrete values: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64, representing the number of samples generated per relation. The y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, is linear and ranges from 20% to 55%, with major tick marks at intervals of 5%. The blue line with circular markers (TACRED) starts at approximately 23% at K=8, rises to 28% at K=16, peaks at 30.5% at K=32, then slightly declines to 29.5% at K=64. The orange line with triangular markers (TACRED-Revisit) begins at 23.5% at K=8, increases to 29.5% at K=16, reaches 31% at K=32, and then decreases slightly to 30% at K=64. The green line with diamond markers (Re-TACRED) starts at 35% at K=8, climbs to 40.5% at K=16, peaks sharply at 50.5% at K=32, and then drops to 48% at K=64. The red line with square markers (SemEval) begins at 42% at K=8, rises steadily to 45% at K=16, continues to 47.5% at K=32, and reaches its highest point at 51.5% at K=64, showing a consistent upward trend across all sample sizes.
model_annotations.German: This line chart displays the Micro F1 (%) performance of the KnowPrompt framework when trained using varying numbers of synthetic training samples generated by large language models, comparing four distinct sampling strategies: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The horizontal x-axis, labeled “Number of Samples Generated,” is categorical and logarithmically spaced, with tick labels at K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64, representing the number of generated samples in thousands. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, is linear and ranges from 20 to 52, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 5 percentage points. The blue line with circular markers, labeled TACRED, begins at approximately 22.8% at K=8, rises to 28.0% at K=16, peaks at 30.5% at K=32, and then declines slightly to 29.5% at K=64. The orange line with triangular markers, labeled TACRED-Revisit, starts at 23.0% at K=8, increases to 29.2% at K=16, reaches 31.0% at K=32, and then decreases to 29.8% at K=64. The green line with diamond markers, labeled Re-TACRED, begins at 34.8% at K=8, rises to 40.3% at K=16, peaks sharply at 50.8% at K=32, and then drops to 47.9% at K=64. The red line with square markers, labeled SemEval, starts at 42.0% at K=8, increases steadily to 45.0% at K=16, continues to 47.5% at K=32, and reaches its maximum of 51.8% at K=64.
